exposure: place of childbirth (outside vs. inside health facility)
cohort: A total of 5,777 Tanzanian women who had given birth within the five years preceding the 2015-2016 survey and provided responses to questions regarding female circumcision were included.
finding: The prevalence of FGM/C was 12.1%, and factors significantly associated with FGM/C included marital status, wealth index, geographic zones, giving birth outside a health facility, higher parity, and the opinion that FGM/C continued.
cross-section timing: Data from the 2015-2016 Tanzania Demographic and Health Survey and Malaria Indicators Survey (TDHS-MIS), focusing on women who gave birth within the five years preceding the survey.
